invariants.description: FIFA Futsal Law 3.1: a match is played by two teams, each with a maximum of five players, one of whom must be the goalkeeper; may not start or resume with fewer than three players.
FIFA Futsal Law 7.1: the match lasts for two equal periods of 20 minutes of playing time, which may only be reduced if permitted by competition rules.

FIFA Futsal Law 10.1/10.2: a goal is scored when the whole of the ball passes over the goal line between the goalposts and under the crossbar; the team scoring the greater number of goals is the winner.
FIFA Futsal Law 10.2: when competition rules require a winner after a draw, permitted procedures include two equal periods of extra time not exceeding five minutes each.
FIFA Futsal Law 13.5: beginning with the sixth accumulated foul by each team in each period, a direct free kick (DFKSAF) applies.
